params.title: Why you forget most of a book

caption.instagram:
You can know 400 words and still freeze ordering a coffee.

Ana was moving to Madrid in 12 weeks and learned 20 new words a night. Six weeks in: 400 words, and she couldn't say one sentence at a café. The words weren't wrong. She'd never said them out loud, together.

The say-it rule:
1. Write the 20 sentences you actually say in a normal day
2. Say all of them out loud every morning
3. Record one minute (about 5 minutes a day in total)

Week 10: she ordered, asked for the bill and chatted with her landlord.

Send this to the friend with a long streak who still can't order a coffee.
